'''Matt Caplan''' is an American actor, singer and voiceover artist who voiced [[Lok Lambert]] in [[Season 2]] of ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]''. In his voiceover work, he is often credited under the name '''Drew Aaron''', as he was for ''Huntik''.
